title: Goodwill Rate on Re-Rating Corrections by Installments Affected
content:
The more installments of the term were billed at a portfolio discount rate of zero, the higher the goodwill rate on a Rental Property Service Contracts re-rating correction.

| Installments of the term billed at a rate of zero | Goodwill rate |
|---|---|
| three or more | 0.20 |
| exactly two | 0.10 |
| one | 0 |

**Records read.** The term's monthly installment charges and the portfolio discount rate each records.

**How the rate acts.** Every goodwill rate on a re-rating correction is added to one in a single sum, and the correction is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

*Hypothetical:* four installments of the term recorded 0.00: 0.20. Two did: 0.10.
